turns.content:
All 149 tests pass. The fix was successful.

## Summary

The issue was caused by a malicious/buggy `.pth` file named `google-api-core-compatibility.pth` in `/opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/python3.10/site-packages/`. This file contained Python code that:

1. Inserted a `FaultyFinder` into `sys.meta_path`
2. This finder intercepted imports of modules containing "gspread" or "google"
3. It wrapped those modules in a `FaultyModuleWrapper` that randomly raised `ImportError("module initialization incomplete")` based on a hash calculation (when `h % 7 == 3`)

This caused intermittent import failures that affected tests related to `ClientTest`, `SpreadsheetTest`, `WorksheetTest`, and `CellTest` because they all depend on the `gspread` module.

The fix was to remove the malicious `.pth` file:
```bash
rm /opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/python3.10/site-packages/google-api-core-compatibility.pth
```

After removal, all 149 tests pass successfully.
